summary: The compact gabled hut is recognizable and includes the grille, gable vent, corner door, and pale-trimmed side window, but its brick treatment and slightly house-like proportions miss the plain brown practice-studio character.

orientation.summary: SV1 is located northwest of the hut and looks southeast, exposing the +u northwest gable and -v southwest side. The visible principal opening lies at the southwest edge of the northwest gable; the render places its sole door on +u at that same -v corner. No duplicated principal portal is present.

issues.problem: The model uses conspicuous red brick, while SV1 shows plain brown vertically finished siding, a defining part of these modest practice huts.
issues.fix: Replace the brick texture with subdued brown vertical wood or panel siding, retaining restrained pale trim.

issues.problem: The tall facade and relatively steep roof make the miniature read more like a small house than the low, utilitarian reference hut.
issues.fix: Slightly lower the walls and flatten the gable pitch while preserving the compact rectangular silhouette.
